notes.title: Happy Halloween!
notes.content:
Have you ever wondered what Halloween is all about? Why "Hello"? Why pumpkins? I didn't have any pumpkins, so buy the game, and I'll purchase an asset with pumpkins.

Anyway, you can think about all of this while you're playing the new level!

notes.title: Ha ha, added music cassettes.
notes.content: Now in some places (so far in one but soon there will be many places), you can pick up a cassette to play RETROWAVE music.

notes.title: Haha I added Spanish and Russian to the game.
notes.content: This is a test version of these languages, if you find any errors please write to me somewhere.

notes.title: Ha-ha I published a game with a critical bug. FIXED.
notes.content: I forgot to enable teleport triggers to the final location. But now it just works.ːsteamthumbsupː
